SOULSPIRE-RITE_OF_KINDLING.title: Rite of Kindling
SOULSPIRE-RITE_OF_KINDLING.description: Upon pickup, add 1 [gold]Estus Flask[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-RITE_OF_KINDLING.flavor: This secret rite allows bonfires to be bolstered further with Kindling.
SOULSPIRE-PURGING_STONE.title: Purging Stone
SOULSPIRE-PURGING_STONE.description: Upon pickup, remove all [gold]Curses[/gold] from your [gold]Deck[/gold], including [gold]Eternals[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-PURGING_STONE.flavor: Even the deepest stains wash away eventually.
SOULSPIRE-DARK_SOUL.title: Dark Soul
SOULSPIRE-DARK_SOUL.description: Upon pickup, add 1 [gold]Hollow[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. When you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-DARK_SOUL.flavor: Soon the flames will fade and only Dark will remain.
SOULSPIRE-BUCKLER.title: Buckler
SOULSPIRE-BUCKLER.description: Whenever you block all damage in a turn, deal 10 damage to ALL enemies and apply 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-BUCKLER.flavor: This shield is specialized for parrying.
SOULSPIRE-GRASS_CREST_SHIELD.title: Grass Crest Shield
SOULSPIRE-GRASS_CREST_SHIELD.description: Start each combat with 3 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Lose 1 of them at the end of your turn.
SOULSPIRE-GRASS_CREST_SHIELD.flavor: The grass crest is lightly imbued with magic, which slightly speeds stamina recovery.
SOULSPIRE-SUNLIGHT_MEDAL.title: Sunlight Medal
SOULSPIRE-SUNLIGHT_MEDAL.description: Upon pickup, add 1 [gold]Jolly Cooperation[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-RING_OF_FAVOR_AND_PROTECTION.d: Upon pickup, gain 5 Max HP. At the start of each combat, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and draw 1 additional card.
SOULSPIRE-RING_OF_FAVOR_AND_PROTECTION.f: A ring symbolizing the favor and protection of the goddess Fina.
SOULSPIRE-THE_MASK_OF_THE_FATHER.title: Mask of the Father
SOULSPIRE-THE_MASK_OF_THE_FATHER.descrip: Whenever you take unblocked damage from an enemy, gain half that much (rounded up) [gold]Strength[/gold] next turn.
SOULSPIRE-THE_MASK_OF_THE_FATHER.flavor: One of the three masks of the Pinwheel, the necromancer who stole the power of the Gravelord.
SOULSPIRE-CHAOS_FLAME_EMBER.title: Chaos Flame Ember
SOULSPIRE-CHAOS_FLAME_EMBER.flavor: Handled only by blacksmiths knowledgeable in ancient methods.
SOULSPIRE-RED_SOAPSTONE_SIGN.title: Red Sign Soapstone
SOULSPIRE-RED_SOAPSTONE_SIGN.flavor: Certain Darkwraiths resist their descent into dark and preserve along the honorable path.
SOULSPIRE-DARKMOON_RING.title: Darkmoon Seance Ring
SOULSPIRE-DARKMOON_RING.description: The first [gold]Power[/gold] you play each combat is played twice.
SOULSPIRE-DARKMOON_RING.flavor: This ring is granted to adherents of Gwyndolin, Darkmoon deity and last born of Gwyn, Lord of Sunlight.
SOULSPIRE-THE_PENDANT.title: The Pendant
SOULSPIRE-THE_PENDANT.description: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Pendant[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-THE_PENDANT.flavor: You! You! Give me, warm. Give me, soft.
